name: regress_shadowlara_50l_pause_radial2
description: Test 50l_pause_radial2 (03.11.): regress_shadowlara_50l_radial2 + tree dlc_test50l_pause (last, wins over autostart_gb): generalbank = autostart_gb 586c37ad + the pause part of TU script 7 (tools/script7_pause_port.py): pause menu open / close send paused / unpaused on PauseMsgCh (hint box, DLC 2 PDA; the uipopupmgr f8 call at the open dropped as in the TU), DLC units send DLC to HODRefresh before the Help-on-Demand refresh (DLC 1 help in the pause menu). No banner, no script 110. New rows: DLC 2 hint box step after the intro, DLC 1 help / hint steps before the quit steps. Docs Befund-Pausemenue-TU.md. Base: Test 50l_radial2 (03.11.): regress_shadowlara_50l_radial with only TruMenu swapped to 0.10.1 (work/asi/menu0101: the radial menu works like a menu - [Radial] Mode=menu: L3 + R3 held / F9 tapped opens the ring and it stays open, left stick / D-pad / mouse pick, only A / Enter / click runs, B back, L3 + R3 / F9 again closes; [Radial] Freeze=world while open (switch radial-freeze, read at every open); built-in top sector Spiel beenden (game.quit, A twice / hold 1 s); built-in level Tests (TO TEST, Regression, Prepare, Schalter, Rundgang from TruMenu.tour.txt); installed next to tru.exe by Set-TruMenu.ps1) and the radial TO TEST rows adapted to the menu mode; the LAST step ends the game through the quit sector, so the Status page quit step only arms / disarms. Update 03.11. afternoon: TruShadowCombat 0.4.1 (work/asi/combat041: [Strike] Translate and [States] Translate1013 read again at run time, at most once per second - the switches sc-strike / sc-translate1013 work without a restart; new steps 13 / 14 at a downed thrall) and the tour file with the level Versteckt (golden shotgun, container1, extended ending - TruMenu.tour.txt in menu0101, no TruMenu rebuild). Everything else as 50l_radial / 50l. Base 50l: Test 50l (morning 03.11.): everything finished of the night in one run. Trees: 48i_tex, 48i_markup (both fully overridden by the merged tree, kept as in 50l_look), dlc_test50l_merged (= dlc_test50l_shaders: TU per-light outfit / thrall / natla shaders, unlit effect libs, look fix of material 20744; + chart fix of DTP 20212 in the same doppelganger_casual.drm (chart_act_u8_fix.py, 4 words); + player_tru_dlc2_extension.drm with the tuning target fix (dlc_test50l_combat); + dlc2_machine_room.drm with the two jump target pads (dlc_test50l_jump)), 50c_vein, 50k_streams, dlc_test50l_shaders_dlc1 (DLC 1 knight thrall copies), dlc_test50l_ach (achievement fix of 31.10.: 11 calls into missing TU natives neutralised in 8 DRMs the installed mods of 30.10. still have), autostart_gb (clean generalbank, [Test] AutoStart). Plugins: TruShadowPower 0.12 (meter interface v3, InstanceParams[1]), TruMenu 0.10.1 (radial menu as a menu; 0.10 R2 spawn; 0.9 Saves, music, Quit now, InputTrace, unstuck, Prepare), TruDataGuard 0.2, TruShadowCombat 0.4.1 (target list, states 1017 / 244, 1013 probe; Translate / Translate1013 off at the start, switchable live), TruDlc2Player 0.2, TruRockVein 0.9, TruDoppelganger, TruLink, TruGuard 0.4. Not in it: dark wall streaks (50m), DLC music (50l_music), HUD (profile regress_shadowlara_50l_hud). Run WITH -Debugger -Session <workbench>\session_thrall_watch.cdb (THRALLLINK hardware write breakpoints).
